title: Banks Act Directive D1/2022 — Liquidity coverage ratio: scope of application and matters related to calculation and disclosure
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Liquidity coverage ratio: scope of application and matters related to calculation and disclosure.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Liquidity coverage ratio: scope of application and matters related to calculation and disclosure.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Liquidity coverage ratio: scope of application and matters related to calculation and disclosure. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
